challenge.name: RoboCall
challenge.description: Welcome to robocall! Let's see how nimbly you navigate this stack.

records.findings_summary: Flag found via Stack depth control to read uninitialized local_20c in cancel_plan, leaking stack-resident flag chunks: sun{you_must_be_some_sort_of_nimble_space_navigator} | Evidence: Flag bytes are scattered onto the stack by place_flag() at local_2028[0x19dc - CHUNK_DEPTH[i]] for 13 chunks (CHUNK_DEPTH = 0x400,0x480,0x520,0x570,0x5a0,0x640,0x690,0x6c0,0x760,0x7b0,0x7e0,0x800,0x880). ; In cancel_plan, the second prompt parses into local_20c at rbp-0x204; if both reads are empty, raw_parse_int does not write it and raw_print_int prints the stale stack value (the flag chunk). ; Choosing menu paths so that rbp_place - rbp_cancel = 0x440 + CHUNK_DEPTH[i] aligns the leaked 4 bytes with each flag chunk; a DFS model found input sequences for all 13 depths. ; Locally verified all 13 chunks against flag.txt, then leaked remotely: sun{ you_ must _be_ some _sor t_of _nim ble_ spac e_na viga tor}
solution_steps: Reverse engineer place_flag: it reads flag.txt and scatters 13 4-byte chunks to stack offsets 0x19dc - CHUNK_DEPTH[i] relative to its 0x2020-byte buffer.
Identify the uninitialized-variable leak in cancel_plan: local_20c (rbp-0x204) is printed before being written when both menu reads are empty.
Model frame sizes (step = sub_rsp + 0x10) and search over menu choices to achieve rbp_place - rbp_cancel = 0x440 + CHUNK_DEPTH[i] for each of the 13 chunks.
Run each crafted interaction locally against the known test flag.txt to confirm all 13 chunks match, then replay identical interactions against nc sunshinectf.games 26199 to recover the real chunks.
evidence: Flag bytes are scattered onto the stack by place_flag() at local_2028[0x19dc - CHUNK_DEPTH[i]] for 13 chunks (CHUNK_DEPTH = 0x400,0x480,0x520,0x570,0x5a0,0x640,0x690,0x6c0,0x760,0x7b0,0x7e0,0x800,0x880).
In cancel_plan, the second prompt parses into local_20c at rbp-0x204; if both reads are empty, raw_parse_int does not write it and raw_print_int prints the stale stack value (the flag chunk).
Choosing menu paths so that rbp_place - rbp_cancel = 0x440 + CHUNK_DEPTH[i] aligns the leaked 4 bytes with each flag chunk; a DFS model found input sequences for all 13 depths.
Locally verified all 13 chunks against flag.txt, then leaked remotely: sun{ you_ must _be_ some _sor t_of _nim ble_ spac e_na viga tor}
